purpose: SIBHIT-R (Idea Desk C) stage A: the historical KXNBAPTS market list (2025-26 season, before the 2026-09-13 historical cutoff), for tickers and time fields. No candle.
heldout: The historical list has no date filter. The scorer keeps only markets whose close_time is inside the window written in the card from Auditor B's hold map, tested before any other field; everything else is LOADED, NOT LOOKED AT. PROPS1's TEST third (read by PROPS1 for price and result) is outside the window. Nothing from the 2026-27 season (live list) is requested.
notes: PROPS1 counted about 9,000 KXNBAPTS markets in 299 events (Mar to Jun 2026), a lower bound. Up to 18 pages of 1,000, cap 20. A last page with a cursor means truncated: the scorer stops.

stop_rules.note: a 429 is waited out with a doubling pause and the same request is asked again; three in a row end the run; no other address, no proxy, no retry around a refusal
